app_store_whats_new:
This update is mostly MeshCore, after a full check against MeshCore's own firmware.

MeshCore contacts now appear where they really are on the map. Positions were read at a tenth of their real scale, which put whole networks in the wrong country. Your radio's full contact list now loads, not just the first twenty or so, and the map markers match the Meshtastic map.

Each MeshCore radio now keeps its own message history and unread counts in an encrypted database, the way Meshtastic radios do, and your conversations no longer vanish when you close the app.

You can now clear a channel's messages from its long-press menu, broadcast your contact across the whole mesh rather than only to nearby radios, and add contacts from contact card links, pasted or scanned. Trace Path follows the contact's route there and back, with a search field and a Retry button. Compressed messages from other MeshCore apps read as normal text.

Fixes:
- Messages are held to what the radio can send, with a byte counter, so long ones no longer fail or arrive cut short.
- Sharing a contact works again for contacts your radio has heard, and the radio's clock is set when you connect.
- Auto-add filters take effect.
- Room server posts no longer start with stray characters, and repeater command replies stay out of your chats.
- Routes that use 2- or 3-byte path hashes, sensor readings, transmit power below 0 dBm and one-hop messages all read correctly.
- Nodes warns when the radio's contact list is full.
- Messages waiting on the radio no longer stall.
- Names with accents or emoji show correctly.
- Emoji are no longer cut in half at the byte limit in MQTT settings and the status message.

play.en-GB: MeshCore contacts appear in the right place on the map, the full contact list loads, and each radio keeps its own encrypted message history. New: clear a channel, broadcast your contact across the mesh, add contacts from card links, and a better Trace Path. Plus many MeshCore fixes, including message length limits, auto-add filters and names with emoji.
